# ErrorPage

The nginx 404.html and 50x.html pages: static HTML and inline CSS, no JavaScript, wordmark, a plain explanation, what to do next, and the request ID on server…

`SongNodes.ErrorPage` · Pages

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.ErrorPage code={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.ErrorPage" code="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (ErrorPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` * | `404 \| 410 \| 500 \| 502 \| 503 \| 504` | HTTP status; 404 uses 404.html, 500/502/503/504 use 50x.html. |
| `requestId` | `string` | nginx $request_id (X-Request-ID) for 50x, shown in mono. |
| `inShell` | `boolean` | In-app route version renders inside the shell; the nginx files are static HTML. |
